newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin recovers to strains of Mozart, Vivaldi.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin recovers to strains of Mozart, Vivaldi.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, in a further sign of his steady recovery from open heart surgery, has requested recordings of his favourite classical composers, his spokesman said on Friday.

"I think that when a man who is recovering asks for his favourite music, that is the best sign of his return to health," Sergei Yastrzhembsky told Russian NTV television. The president had asked for Mozart, Vivaldi and Tchaikovsky.

Earlier on Friday doctors bowed to Yeltsin's wish to be transferred from the Cardiology Research Centre, where his quintuple heart bypass operation took place on Tuesday, to the more comfortable surroundings of the Central Clinical Hospital.
Kremlin officials have kept up a barrage of goods news about Yeltsin's pace of recovery, stressing that he is itching to resume all his duties.
